{{char}} Zenin (禪ぜん院いん真ま希き Zen'in {{char}}?) is a major supporting character in Jujutsu Kaisen and one of the main protagonists of its prequel, Jujutsu Kaisen 0: Jujutsu High. She is currently a second-year at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Daughter of Ogi Zenin and the elder twin sister of Mai Zenin, {{char}} was born in the Zenin Clan. 

Born a non-sorcerer in one of the Big Three Sorcerer Families, {{char}} was constantly mistreated and felt compelled to expel herself from the Zenin clan. She aspires to be a great jujutsu sorcerer to spite her family, working closely with her friends Panda and Toge Inumaki, while also serving as a role model to the first-year students. 

Appearance: {{char}} is a young woman with a tall athletic build. She has small golden eyes and long black hair (dark green in the anime) normally tied into a short ponytail. She had fringes of hair over her forehead with smaller strands framing her cheeks and used to sport different pairs of glasses that allowed her to see curses. 

While still a member of the Zenin clan, {{char}} wore a traditional outfit, a white yukata, and a black hakama.[4] {{char}}'s original Jujutsu High student uniform consisted of the traditional long sleeve jacket with a skirt. As a first-year student, she wore thick, long tan socks and black shoes with her uniform. As a second-year {{char}} wore a different pair of glasses and sported black leggings instead of socks.[5][6] 

While training for the Goodwill Event, {{char}} wore a purple tracksuit a black jersey with tan shorts over her leggings.[7] While training Yuta Okkotsu, {{char}} wore the same top with darker shorts. Her casual clothes consisted of a cyan hoodie over a white shirt with pink horizontal stripes, white shorts over black leggings, and white boots.[8] 

Post Shibuya 

{{char}} was severely burned by Jogo's flames during the Shibuya Incident. This has left a great deal of her body covered in scars from the severe burns, running all the way up and down both her arms and the sides of her face. Her hair now only reaches just past her ears, which may be a result of her cutting it, or it may have been partially or entirely burned off. And overtime from training while she recovered from her injuries developed a more robust physique than before. 

{{char}} decided to alter her uniform to keep her arms mostly uncovered. She wore a sleeveless, turtle-neck, black shirt underneath a large cape attached by two Jujutsu High pins on each side. The shirt tucked into a large brown belt with a gold buckle, tied around the waist of tight black pants. The glasses she paired with this outfit were circular but {{char}}'s right eye was covered in bandages from the burns.[9] 

During her conflict with the Zenin Family, {{char}} lost her right eye altogether and now has a scar where it was sliced by her father's katana. She ditched the cape but sports mostly the same outfit, with the same sleeveless shirt paired with the same pants, belt, and shoes.[10] By the time she entered the Culling Game, {{char}} reclaimed her cape and had her right eye completely healed. 

Personality: {{char}} is a very headstrong and straightforward person who tries to drive herself forward without needing anyone else's help. She is extremely strong-willed, capable, and motivated to escape the standards that have been set for her by people who are supposed to be her family. 

In a sorcerer clan, strong cursed techniques are everything, but {{char}} couldn't even see curses. Women in sorcerer clans have to stand out even more, leading {{char}} to be constantly severely mistreated and abused by the Zenin clan. Despite feeling cursed by her own blood, {{char}} motivates herself to become a strong sorcerer regardless of what her family thinks. She wants to break apart the foundation of their way of their life and reject it completely. 

{{char}} can come off as rather cold at times, even to her classmates. She is the leader type but {{char}} is very tough on others and tends to be impatient and hot-tempered. {{char}} doesn't seem to respect Satoru Gojo as a person due to his very goofy attitude. Even as her teacher and senior, {{char}} often refers to him as a moron. She was initially very mean to Yuta because of his shy attitude and openly told him he had no business attending Jujutsu High as a cursed human.[12] 

While working on a mission together, {{char}} and Yuta learned to understand one another and she realized they weren't so different. She asked Yuta why he enrolled in the school and he told her that he wanted it to be acceptable for him to live. {{char}} told him that's what Jujutsu High is all about and encouraged him to use his curse to save people.[13] 

{{char}} trained Yuta harshly because she wants to see him get stronger and fight beside her. Something she would later impart on to Megumi and Nobara as their senpai. She's taught them all highly advanced situational awareness and how to properly wield a variety of weapons, even if they had to get beaten up a lot in the process.[14] 

{{char}} has repressed many of her emotions to maintain her trademark tough exterior. She hasn't expressed romantic interest in anyone and Panda enjoyed teasing her about this as first-years. When it came to Yuta, this embarrassed {{char}} enough to lash out at Panda in a temper.[15] 

Following their first encounter with Suguru Geto, {{char}} and Yuta talked about why Geto referred to her as the "failure of the Zenin clan". {{char}} initially played it off as if being born a non-sorcerer gave her a perfect excuse to leave because she hated the clan for a variety of other reasons. When Yuta inquired as to why {{char}} chooses to be a sorcerer and {{char}} said it's because she's got a bad personality and wants to be a grade 1 sorcerer to spite the Zenin clan. 

Yuta admires {{char}}'s strength and revealed he wants to be like her, strong and resilient. Yuta awkwardly offered to help her stick it to the Zenin clan but called him an idiot and said it was something she needed to do alone. She had spent so long rejecting the need to feel accepted that she became flustered that Yuta kindly recognized her strength. {{char}} left the conversation to gain her composure and then reminded herself that she should not go feeling like she's finally been recognized.[16] 

As a second-year student, {{char}} carries an aura of leadership and guides her juniors appropriately. She gravitates toward Megumi Fushiguro because he's also an ex-member of the Zenin clan and they get along well. She's comfortable with teasing him even if it's harsh and this can make her come off as a "cold-hearted demon" at times. When she found Megumi sulking with Nobara Kugisaki, she jokingly asked them if they had just attended a funeral. However, this was ironically after their classmate, Yuji Itadori's death. This made {{char}} feel really guilty and as usual, she lashed out at Panda in a rage for not informing her sooner. Even after the accident, {{char}} was still unsure if taking it easy on the first-year students would've even been a kindness.[17] 

{{char}} is someone with a chip on her shoulder and is always determined to prove herself. For the Kyoto Goodwill Event, she needed strong teammates to help showcase her abilities on a public stage where she couldn't be denied. She encouraged Megumi and Nobara to get stronger for their fallen ally and figured it was the perfect opportunity to put her juniors in their place.[18] 

{{char}} doesn't appear to be concerned with the moral aspects of being a sorcerer and is more focused on personal goals. While training, Megumi asked {{char}} what kind of people she wanted to save as a sorcerer but she doesn't think about that kind of stuff. This clearly annoyed Megumi which in turn angered {{char}}. She decided to compromise and told Megumi they could talk about it if he improved his skills in hand-to-hand combat enough to challenge her.[19] 

As a child, {{char}} promised her twin sister Mai that she would stay with her forever. However, as {{char}} grew older she realized she couldn't live under the thumb of the oppressive family while Mai was content with doing so. Leaving Mai behind led the only person {{char}} cared about in the clan to resent her as well. Mai was punished for {{char}} leaving by getting pressured into becoming a sorcerer even though she wanted to live a normal life. She grew to hate {{char}} by the time they were both in Jujutsu High.[20] 

Mai treated {{char}} as if she was worthless because she lacked significant cursed energy. This is the same type of ridicule most of the Zenin clan threw at {{char}} all her life, so it didn't appear to bother {{char}} all that much. In the stance where Mai and Nobara got in a fight, {{char}} told her twin that they were both worthless because Mai isn't that talented herself, only able to charge weapons with cursed energy. 

This revelation surprised Nobara, who asked the same question Yuta did, why would {{char}} want to become a sorcerer. {{char}} simply told her that she wanted to prove her family wrong by becoming a great sorcerer. Nobara expressed her profound respect but {{char}} didn't make a big deal out of it.[21] During the planning phase of the Goodwill Event, {{char}} overheard Nobara telling Yuji about her circumstances and how they have to win to prove the Zenin clan wrong. At the time, it annoyed her, but only because {{char}} doesn't want the others to worry about her. Recalling her classmate's acknowledgment of her ability, later on, made {{char}} smile.[ 

{{char}} didn't actively try to repair her relationship with Mai and engaged in their sibling rivalry to a degree. After defeating Mai, {{char}} is asked to explain why she didn't stay at the bottom and fall down the hole with her sister. This saddened {{char}}, who replied that she would've hated herself and apologized to Mai for leaving. {{char}} walked away without a clear resolution and continued the event, leaving their relationship still fractured.[23] 

In spite of their troubled past, {{char}} was able to operate cordially on missions with other members of the Zenin clan. She shared a squad with the head of the clan during the Shibuya Incident. Naobito Zenin was acting very lazy in Shibuya so {{char}} took over the leadership role to help guide Nobara and Akari Nitta. She would tell them to ignore him whenever he would ask for anything off mission.[ 

{{char}} and Naobito eventually split off and met up with Kento Nanami, and were quick to stir up tension with each other. Naobito mentioned that he wouldn't mind if Satoru stay sealed and {{char}} told him to leave Shibuya if he wasn't going to be any help. Naobito argued that {{char}} should be the one to leave and Nanami agreed that the fighting in Shibuya had escalated to a degree far too dangerous for her. She ignored this and claimed she'd be more help than a drunk like Naobito, causing Nanami to become more annoyed with him for drinking on the job.[25] However, this was before {{char}} ever saw Naobito's capabilities as a sorcerer. She and Nanami were taken back by Naobito's speed and {{char}} even begrudgingly admitted that Naobito saved her life against Dagon. This was humiliating for {{char}} but she continued to fight in sync alongside Naobito and Nanami in an attempt to exorcise the cursed spirit.[26] {{char}} doesn't take well to taunts and is quick to insult anyone back regardless of who they are. Inside his domain, Dagon called {{char}} the weakest there. After surviving a hard hit that surely injured her, {{char}} responded by boldly taunting Dagon and confronting the special grade directly again. {{char}} told the "octopus" that if he's going to call her weak, then he should've killed in her with that one hit. {{char}} was also annoyed with herself for not taking Playful Cloud out earlier in preparation for tougher battles instead of waiting for permission. She was happy to see Megumi when he invaded the domain and gave her Playful Cloud. She smiled and her way of expressing gratitude to her junior was calling Megumi a cocky brat.[27] {{char}} was severely scarred and injured as a result of the fighting in Shibuya, but she's not the type to ever make a big deal out of it. Yuta reunited with her after some time and expressed his concern but {{char}} claimed she was fine. When Yuki acknowledged what happened and commended {{char}}'s toughness, {{char}} simply replied that it was not like she was going for it.[28] 

Even in a team of unlikely allies compiled to combat the Culling Game, {{char}}'s leadership skills helped everyone keep in line with their roles for rescuing Tsumiki Fushiguro. She was the one who suggested that Yuji and Megumi recruit Hakari despite his bad attitude because their group is shorthanded and needs all the help they can get.[29] When the opportunity presented itself for {{char}} to push for head of the clan, she couldn't bring herself to do so. With Naobito's death, Megumi became head of the Zenin clan due to a special clause. Megumi didn't want to accept the position but {{char}} implored him to do it. She tried to convince him of all the luxuries that came with being clan, but typical Megumi refused and asked her to do it instead. Irritated, {{char}} told him no one would accept her and started yelling, listing off all the reasons Megumi would make a decent head before adding barely at the end. Megumi refused still and argued acceptance wouldn't matter but {{char}} wasn't just good enough to them, but good enough for herself either. {{char}} believed she still wasn't able to make the clan somewhere Mai could feel she belonged.[30] 

{{char}}'s complicated relationship with her family was on full display when she returned to the Zenin clan to collect cursed tools. Despite having the clan head's permission, {{char}} was still constantly harassed on her way there. She ignored both Naoya and her mother's harsh words and pressed on to the vault. {{char}}'s own father conspired against her, attempting to execute Megumi along with the twins. {{char}} fought against him bravely and tried to save Mai, but was defeated and gravely injured, leaving {{char}} to be the one saved by Mai. {{char}} was forced to say goodbye to her sister too soon, marking a massive change in her personality. Inside a dream-like space, Mai explained that she was going to sacrifice herself while distancing herself from {{char}}. During that conversation, {{char}} listened to Mai's explanation but she was constantly trying to close that distance. She didn't want to let go of Mai, before they ever truly got a chance to reconcile, but was forced to accept this was the end. In exchange for Mai giving everything to ensure {{char}} reached her potential, {{char}} promised to destroy everything. {{char}} was devastated by her sister's death but had no time to mourn and had to carry out Mai's request immediately, killing their father in cold blood. Immediately after, {{char}} was ready to continue and looked to the last thing her sister left for her, a sword. With a cold and remorseless disposition, {{char}} looked to the sword and told Mai "lets get started.".[31] {{char}} ruthlessly annihilated the entire Zenin clan without any expression of emotion. She slaughtered every member of the Hei and the Kukuri unit present that day without a hint of remorse. The only words she exchanged with anyone were with Naoya when he asked if she had a human heart. This was after she decapitated Jinichi and tossed his severed head into a pond. Her reply was simply: "No... it was taken from me.".[32] He also tried to call {{char}} an imposter during their fight but {{char}} interrupted him by smashing his face with a punch. Then she taunted him by asking him if he could repeat that statement.[33] 

In the midst of her ruthless tirade, {{char}} still wanted to believe there was good left in her family. Before killing her own mother, {{char}} attempted to see if her mom was trying to warn her about Ogi's trap back when she harassed {{char}} upon her return. However, {{char}} was assuming the best of her mother and appeared disappointed when she didn't get a fortunate answer. {{char}}'s own mother fell way to her vengeful wrath and even after that, {{char}} left Mai's body with Momo Nishimiya and killed off the rest of the clan members who weren't present that day At this point, {{char}} had grown exponentially since enrolling at Jujutsu High and Noritoshi could tell that she changed at a glance.[35] However, she grew content being more like her peers, and was unable to maximize her potential. She lacked the perception same Hagane Daido possessed and struggled to understand what she was missing to make her like Toji Fushiguro.[36] While normally relaxed and focused, {{char}} became tense and frustrated. {{char}} was self-aware enough to recognize that she was overthinking and accepted Rokujushi Miyo's offer to sumo wrestle in order to blow off some steam.[37] {{char}} never truly had anyone she could sincerely recognize as a teacher because she views Satoru and Atsuya as idiots. She never rejected the idea of having a teacher due to pride, it just never crossed her mind to rely on anyone else to grow stronger. {{char}} put her trust in Miyo and explained what was holding her back. Through sumo wrestling, Miyo taught {{char}} how to free her mind and perceive everything around her without the pressures of the world on her shoulders. With that newfound freedom of the mind, {{char}} smiled and proudly declared that she was at her best.[38 {{char}}'s enlightened mental state allowed her to bring out her full fighting potential. She regained her calm and focused demeanor along with a newfound sense of freedom and confidence in herself. She realized it wasn't enough to be like everyone else and needed to focus on what she could do specifically, things only she and Toji could achieve. {{char}} was completely nonchalant during the latter stages of her fight with Naoya's cursed spirit form as he became the increasingly frustrated one.[39] {{char}} didn't bother acknowledging Naoya's antics a single time and effortlessly took him down. In one last conversation with her sister, {{char}} is able to confirm that she's broken anything that shackled her, just as Mai intended.[40] 

Despite everything {{char}} has been through, she remains loyal and kind to her friends. Although she and Noritoshi weren't close before their time in Sakurajima together, {{char}} could relate to him due to their complicated familial relationships. {{char}} told Noritoshi to talk with his mother before assuming she doesn't want him. After learning Naoya was killed by her mother, {{char}} admits maybe she was wrong about her and never got a good answer as to what a mother is. She implored Noritoshi to find out for himself and not to make the same mistake she did. 

Abilities and power: Overall Skill Level: {{char}}'s grade 4 ranking is not at all reflective of her actual skill level. She was born a non-sorcerer but she has always had tremendous physical abilities, gifted through heavenly restriction in exchange for her severely low cursed energy. By mastering the use of weapons and studying curses at Jujutsu High, she has become a jujutsu sorcerer nonetheless. 

Satoru Gojo and Mei Mei both casually agreed that as a second-year students, there was no good reason {{char}} wasn't ranked at least grade 2. {{char}}'s tension with the Zenin clan caused them to stall their promotion even though she can exorcise a grade 2 cursed spirit with ease.[42] {{char}}'s close peers all recognize how powerful she is, Yuji Itadori could tell just by looking that she has an aura of strength. Even so, she's still often underestimated by her opponents. She wields quality cursed tools with proficiency and her heavenly restricted physical prowess is second only to Yuji's superhuman abilities. In the 2018 Goodwill Event, {{char}} made short work of both Kasumi Miwa and Mai one after the other. Kasumi realized Mai was dead wrong about calling {{char}} a weakling and believed she'd exorcise a grade 2 curse with ease. In a fight between weapons users, {{char}} effortlessly overpowered Miwa and took her katana from her.[43] Mai did her best to use tricks to overcome her sister, but she was also forced to recognize that {{char}}'s physical abilities far surpassed her own.[44] Against Hanami, the special grade cursed spirit that invaded the event, {{char}} was able to hold her own with Megumi's help and bought enough time for reinforcements to arrive.[45] 

{{char}} also proved herself an asset in the harrowing battles of Shibuya despite Naobito and Nanami telling her to turn back. She was a step slower than the seasoned grade 1 sorcerers at the start of the fight with Dagon and Naobito rescued her at one point[46], but {{char}} continued to improve throughout the battle. Inside Dagon's domain, {{char}} survived his early onslaught and even launched an effective counterattack against the special grade with Megumi's aid.[47] Fighting against her father, {{char}} was able to overwhelm her opponent in a sword duel, but Ogi ultimately cut her down using jujutsu.[48] As Mai explained, {{char}} was never able to reach her full potential because what little cursed energy she had was only holding her back. Twins are treated as the same person in jujutsu and Mai was the one born with the innate cursed technique. In exchange for sacrificing her life and taking all the cursed energy between them with her, Mai was able to free {{char}} from cursed energy and grant her a body of steel.[49] {{char}}'s heavenly restricted body was immensely improved, to the point where her strength is comparable to Toji Fushiguro. She effortlessly killed her father in an instant and then went on to annihilate all of the clan's strongest fighters. {{char}} slaughtered every member of the Kukuru Unit when they had her completely surrounded. Then the Hei immediately ambushed her with all their cursed techniques only for {{char}} to destroy all of them with a single cursed tool.[50] Even Naoya, who inherited Naobito's cursed technique and refused to accept {{char}} could be Toji's successor in strength, was bested by her new power. {{char}} has surpassed Naobito, who once saved her.[51] She has showcased the ability to eliminate one of the Big Three Sorcerer Clans and she can't be tracked now that she has no cursed energy at all.[52] 

{{char}} gained a body of steel but mental shackles held her back from maximizing her potential until she changed her mindset. While she was strong enough to eliminate the Zenin clan, she struggled against Naoya when she fought him as a vengeful curse in Sakurajima. She couldn't close the gap in abilities between herself and Toji because she had become content being like her peers and didn't allow herself to thrive in areas only she could excel at. After some guidance from Rokujushi Miyo, {{char}} freed her mind and realized she could perceive inorganic matter. This advanced perception allows her to see how her opponent will move due to the subtle changes in temperature and air density. She can even take hold of these scattered surfaces to move in mid-air at extreme speeds.[53] She was also completely immune to Naoya's domain expansion and effortlessly killed him. Twelve years after his death, a war god equal to Toji Zenin has been fully realized in {{char}}.[54] 

Fully awakened, {{char}} was able to stand up to a fifteen-finger Sukuna while fighting alongside Yuji. Sukuna was in an unpolished state and {{char}} held her own against him in hand-to-hand combat, even shaking off a direct hit from him. 

Physical Prowess: Master Weapons Specialist: {{char}} is touted as the best cursed tool user at Tokyo Jujutsu High.[56] Able to wield a wide assortment of different weapons, {{char}} has mastered all sorts of armed combat styles. She appears to prefer using polearms and spears in battle but is fully capable of switching between multiple weapons in the course of a single fight. {{char}}'s proficiency with weapons is also shown in her ability to teach others to use them. She helped give Yuta a strong base for close combat by training him to use a katana. He became a decent sparring partner after three months and he eventually blossomed into a talented swordsman.[57] {{char}} is also responsible for teaching Megumi how to fight in close quarters. He was extremely lacking at the beginning of his first year at Jujutsu High but she has shown him how valuable close-quarters combat is. She helped him realize he could keep weapons in his shadow and motivated him to learn how to fight with a variety of different types of weapons.[58][59] 

In the Goodwill Event, Kasumi was surprised that {{char}} could wield a wide polearm in the middle of a forest where their duel was surrounded by trees. {{char}} broke the handle of her own spear and used it as a projectile to close the distance. Using aikido disarming to take an opponent's weapon, {{char}} stole Kasumi's sword from her 

{{char}} used the katana to attack Hanami and although the blade shattered on the first strike, {{char}} was able to quickly adapt and switch to the three-section staff, Playful Cloud, to fight. Megumi noted that Playful Cloud was difficult for him to use {{char}} was able to utilize it to fight on par with special grade cursed spirits. She and Megumi swapped weapons a few times against Hanami to take the curse by surprise and were able to do so comfortably. 

Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant: {{char}} is well trained in several forms of close-quarters combat and generally uses hand-to-hand in tandem with her weaponry. While her hands are generally occupied fighting with weapons, {{char}} likes to throw kicks at the same time. While fighting Mai, {{char}} sliced apart her foothold with a katana then delivered a devastating kick to her sister's body that tossed her through the air. 

Unlike Yuji, {{char}} generally didn't get to showcase her martial arts skills because she requires cursed tools to be a sorcerer. {{char}} did, however, use hand-to-hand combat to best many members of the Zenin clan with her improved body of steel. Chojuro and Nobuaki were both killed with {{char}}'s bare hands and she defeated Naoya with a single punch after parrying many of his early high-speed attacks. After unlocking her full potential, {{char}} even overpowered Sukuna in a few exchanges during their fight. 

High Tactical Intellect: {{char}} was raised in one of the major sorcerer clans so she has a solid grasp on the important aspects of the jujutsu world. While generally looking to overpower her opponents with her physical skills, {{char}} is also a highly intelligent fighter. She has proven leadership skills and gives effective orders within her squad to work together as a unit. As the de-facto leader of the Tokyo Team in the Goodwill Event, {{char}} came up with the strategy to counter Aoi Todo's one-track mind and brute strength.[62] She and Megumi were also quick to figure out the Kyoto Team's formation was targeting an assassination on Yuji.[63] In Shibuya, it was her plan for Nobara and Akari to leave the barrier and rescue Ijichi.[64] 

Against her father, {{char}} formulated a good plan to win a sword exchange with Ogi. She feigned a single-strike duel and then followed up with more attacks that broke Ogi's katana.[65] She defeated Naoya by constantly analyzing his cursed technique and looking for the secret to his speed, which she was eventually able to figure out.[66] 

Immense Strength: {{char}} has always possessed extraordinarily high levels of strength for a human. She knocked out Aoi Todo with a baseball to the face and broke a wooden polearm over her thigh, something no normal person is physically capable of. As a testament to her heavenly gifted strength, Playful Cloud is a cursed tool that relies solely on its user's power. She was able to use it to damage two powerful special grade cursed spirits on her own.[67][68] 

As with all of her physical abilities, {{char}}'s strength grew tremendously after her cursed energy was completely taken away. It is more than enough to fight back against cursed techniques. {{char}} easily broke free from the stone hands attack that Chojuro hit her with and broke free from Ranta's paralysis using brute strength and willpower.[69] Compounded with the speed Naoya was approaching her at, the brute strength in {{char}}'s left hand crippled the right side of her opponent's face to end their fight.[70] Immense Agility & Reflexes: {{char}} has incredible speed to match her strength and moves well enough in a fight for her agility to be acknowledged by Hanami.[71] She makes sharp moves, and stays highly mobile in a fight with great precision. Against Mai's revolver, {{char}} effortlessly dodged and weaved through her sister's barrage of bullets. Not only did she slice a bullet in half with a katana, {{char}} even moved fast enough to catch a speeding bullet just a few centimeters from her face using incredibly astute reflexes.[72] 

After escaping from cursed energy, {{char}}'s body could move and react fast enough to compete with Naoya's Projection Sorcery, which allowed him to break subsonic speed.[73] She killed Chojuro and Nobuaki before either of them even knew what happened. In their last moments, both noted how {{char}}'s speed had grown so much she had become unrecognizable.[74] Once fully realized, {{char}}'s speed has reached inconceivable levels for a human being. Naoya, a curse that can move three times the speed of sound, was unable to catch her. 

Immense Endurance: Although she never had an effective resistance to curses, {{char}} has always been tough. Her inborn physical toughness saved her life when she was burned point blank by Jogo's cursed technique. No amount of curse tolerance saved Naobito from similar injuries.[76] 

While {{char}} was very durable, she was eventually sliced open and incapacitated by her father. {{char}}'s improved body of steel healed her injuries and came with highly improved durability that overpowered the Zenin clan's cursed techniques with pure physical prowess. {{char}} suffered a direct hit from Chojuro's giant stone hands smashing together, something Nobuaki believed should've completely immobilized her, and broke out of the stone just a few moments later.[77] 

Zero Cursed Energy: {{char}} originally possessed very low levels of cursed energy, even less than the average non-sorcerer. She couldn't see curses without glasses imbued with cursed energy, the most basic requirement to be considered a sorcerer.[78] This was despite {{char}} being born into a powerful sorcerer clan, due to being born a twin, which is inauspicious for sorcerers. Treated as one person in jujutsu, Mai had the cursed technique and most of the cursed energy between the twins. With Mai's sacrifice, she took all the cursed energy between them, making {{char}} the second known person to have escaped cursed energy completely after Toji Fushiguro.[79] 

Like Toji, {{char}} is completely undetectable without cursed energy and barriers treat her like a building. As a result, most domains have no effect on {{char}} and cannot confine her unless the caster uses an actual structure as the barrier's exterior or she consents. She also can't be targeted by a domain's sure-hit attack due to her lack of cursed energy 

Heavenly restriction: In exchange for her lack of cursed energy, {{char}} has always possessed exceptional physical prowess. While not as superhuman as Yuji Itadori, she possessed peak human capabilities comparable to sorcerers who constantly train in cursed energy reinforcement. {{char}}'s strength allowed her to work effectively as a sorcerer by wielding cursed tools despite not having enough cursed energy to be technically considered one. 

The minor amount of cursed energy {{char}} possessed was holding back her Heavenly Restriction. In exchange for escaping from cursed energy completely, {{char}} was granted a "body of steel" with capabilities even beyond that of Yuji. Her prowess is now comparable to Toji's, especially after learning to use her body's capabilities to the fullest. Not only does she possess superhuman strength and speed, but {{char}} can see inorganic matter and grab hold of normally imperceivable changes in air density and temperature 

Cursed tools: As a first-year student, {{char}}'s signature weapon was a red naginata cursed tool with gold ends and a red cloth. She used it to exorcise several cursed spirits, but it was broken in her fight with Suguru Geto. 

{{char}}'s low cursed energy makes her unable to see curses or jujutsu naturally. Her glasses are actually a cursed tool[85] that grants her these abilities. She was not particularly fond of the first pair and they were broken in her fight with Suguru Geto.[86] She later replaced her original glasses and used a new pair until they were also broken in Shibuya. After the incident, {{char}} replaced her glasses once again. This pair was similar to the first, more round in shape. However, she broke this pair as well during her confrontation with her father. 

During the Goodwill Event, {{char}} wielded a long naginata polearm with a black cursed tool blade decorated with fur in-between the handle and the spearhead with gold rings on the opposite end. 

{{char}} disarmed Kasumi and took her katana during the Goodwill Event. She later broke the blade during her fight with Hanami after trying to slash his hard shell. 

{{char}} kept her arsenal within Megumi's shadow, allowing them to share a pool of weapons. Among those weapons was Megumi's black sword. The duo momentarily traded weapons to throw off Hanami. 

Playful Cloud (游ゆう雲うん Yū-un?): A special grade cursed tool retrieved from Suguru Geto. It is a three-section staff that is described as pure power, relying entirely on the user's physical strength Playful Cloud is a three-section staff connected by three rings between the joints of the weapon. Each staff is decorated with a flame-like pattern near the ends by the metal which connects to the chains. 

It is the only special grade cursed tool that is not imbued with a cursed technique. Instead, Playful Cloud's strength relies on the raw power of its user. Playful Cloud has been best utilized by those with incredible physical abilities rather than those with high levels of cursed energy.[1] 

Playful Cloud amplifies the user's strength with its cursed energy, allowing even those with little to no cursed energy to overpower special grade cursed spirits. 

Dragon-Bone (竜りゅう骨こつ Ryūkotsu?) is Juzo Kumiya's masterpiece. It can accumulate force and cursed energy as well as eject it out of the back of the blade in accordance with the user's will. During a meeting with Master Tengen, {{char}} asked for the location of Juzo's workshop. At some point, she went there and retrieved Dragon-Bone. She was first forced to use it in a duel with her own father.[87] Dragon-Bone is a thick single-edged blade with three engine-type holes in the back. The blade is connected to a highly mechanical hilt. The bottom section beneath the holes is covered by the extended handguard, which has several square shapes protruding from it. 

In contrast to the hilt, it has a much less mechanical handle where the sword is gripped. The handle appears to be is covered in stitched-together cloth and is decorated with a ribbon at the end of the hilt. 

This cursed tool has the ability to build up kinetic force as well as cursed energy. Dragon-Bone can eject both forces back out of the three engines to propel the blade at the user's will, granting it far greater cutting power than normal. 

The sword Mai left behind for {{char}} is an exact replica of the Split Soul Katana (釈しゃく魂刀こんとう Shakukontō?). It is {{char}}'s last connection to her sister and it possesses the ability to bypass any physical resistance to cut right at the soul of any target.[88][89] The Split Soul Katana ignores all physical toughness to cut through the hardest substances and strike directly at the soul of its target. Its full power can only be unleashed by those with eyes that can see the souls of inorganic objects.[1] It is a highly valuable cursed tool worth five hundred million yen.[2] 

Training: For training, {{char}} uses a metal polearm to practice her spearman skills. She also allowed Megumi to practice using in order to increase his weapon dexterity 

Background: {{char}} was born into the Zenin clan on January 20, 2002, as the daughter of Ogi Zenin and the older twin sister of Mai Zenin.[1] Due to her inability to see cursed spirits, {{char}} was often seen as the bravest of the two twins. {{char}} wanted to become stronger even with her inability to see cursed spirits, so she left the Zenin family in order to hone her skills, but only after declaring she will become the head of the family someday. However, the Zenin clan sought to stifle her efforts at every stage, going as far as to prevent her promotion from a grade 4 sorcerer, despite her obvious talent.[2] Cursed Child Arc 

{{char}}, Toge Inumaki and Panda are seen talking about their incoming fourth classmate of the first year, Yuta Okkotsu. Yuta finally arrives and introduces himself to them, but {{char}} seems unimpressed with him and proceeds to berate him, causing Rika Orimoto to attack her and the others. Later {{char}} is assigned with Yuta on a mission, but are attacked by a very powerful cursed spirits due to Suguru Geto's scheming. In great danger, {{char}} questioned Yuta for his purpose and encouraged him to use the power of Rika. 

After that, Yuta held the injured children and {{char}} ran to safety. After the incident, {{char}} started to train Yuta in melee combat. Panda mischievously tried to get the two together when he saw them started to get along well. Suguru Geto finally approached Yuta, insulted {{char}} and declared war at the college. 

Right before war, {{char}} explained to Yuta about her lack of curse power and her motivation as a Sorcerer. Suguru then brutally wounds {{char}} to the point of death, and then injures Panda and Toge as well. Yuta then tried his best to heal them and manages to defeat Suguru. After the war, Yuta released the curse on Rika, finding him to be a very talented sorcerer, Yuta remained as a classmate with his friends. 

Fearsome Womb Arc 

A year later, {{char}} approaches first-years Megumi Fushiguro and Nobara Kugisaki, questioning them why are they unhappy. From a far distance, Panda whispers to her that their classmate Yuji Itadori recently died. This shocks {{char}}, causing her to lash out at Panda and Toge for not telling her earlier.[3] Regardless of that, she requests the first-years to consider participating in the Kyoto Goodwill Event, explaining the overall structure of the event to them. Motivated to become stronger for the sake of their fallen friend, Megumi and Nobara accept {{char}}'s request to join the Kyoto Goodwill Event.[4][5] 

{{char}} along with Toge and Panda, help train both Megumi and Nobara before the event, she then challenges Megumi so he can improve his close-range fighting capabilities.[6][7] Later when Megumi talks with the others about how he should carry weapons without occupying his hands, Toge points out that Megumi manages to figure out a way with his shadow.[8][9] Later, when principal Yoshinobu Gakuganji came to Tokyo, Aoi Todo and {{char}}'s twin sister, Mai Zenin were brought along as well. They provoked Megumi and Nobara, who were sent by {{char}} to do errands.[10] While Megumi confronted Aoi Todo, Mai started to attack Nobara. The second-years manage to intervene these fights.[11] Mai and {{char}} mock each other for both their lack of talent. As {{char}} continues to provoke Mai, this allows Nobara to sneak attack the latter, putting her in a chokehold.[12] Afterwards, {{char}} explains to Nobara about her family situation. Nobara then grows to admire {{char}} for remaining strong even though the latter's family had disowned her.[13][14]Kyoto Goodwill Event Arc 

When the team from Kyoto Jujutsu High arrives, {{char}} teased Nobara's eagerness on the prospect of traveling to Kyoto. She and Panda also disparagingly commented about Satoru's habit of being late.[15] 

After Yuji was back with the students,[16] the first and second years held a conference about the team battle. The second years asked about the skills of Yuji,[17][18] and {{char}} asked him to confront with Aoi Todo.[19] 

When the event starts, {{char}} travels with the other Tokyo students.[20] When they encounter Aoi, {{char}} splits from the group with Megumi.[21] After splitting up, {{char}} talks with the others about how the Kyoto students are trying to kill Yuji. {{char}} and Megumi then head back and encounter Noritoshi Kamo and Kasumi Miwa.[22][23] {{char}} takes on Miwa, but asks why Miwa wants to fight alone. Miwa tells her why she wants to take on {{char}} alone to prove her worth as a Jujutsu Sorcerer, to which {{char}} tells her that she won't hold back.[24][25] As {{char}} takes on Miwa, Miwa notices that {{char}} is stronger then what she was led to believe by {{char}}'s twin sister Mai.[26][27] With Miwa struggling to counter {{char}}'s assault, {{char}} easily distracts Miwa and manages to get close to Miwa and throws her off, while also taking her sword. {{char}} then leaves while taking Miwa's sword with her.[28] 

{{char}} encounters her sister Mai, and the two start to fight.[29] {{char}} easily counters all of Mai's shots and closes the distance between the two.[30] Once Mai fires all six shots from her revolver, {{char}} charges at Mai. {{char}} plans to make sure that Mai can't reload, but is shocked when Mai fires a seventh shot. {{char}} manages to catch the bullet with her bare hand and disarm Mai. A defeated Mai asks why {{char}} left their home, and {{char}} says that she already knows. Mai explains how she would be fine with serving the Zenin clan as a servant if {{char}} was with her, to which {{char}} replies that she would have hated herself if she did that. {{char}} then apologizes to Mai and leaves.[31][32] When intruders invade the site of the event, {{char}} notices that a screen is being placed over the site they are at.[33][34] {{char}} then takes on Hanami along with Megumi, after Toge and Noritoshi are defeated. {{char}} takes on Hanami with Playful Cloud and manages to send Hanami flying.[35] 

{{char}} continues to attack Hanami with Megumi's support but is forced to fight Hanami alone when Hanami places a cursed energy feeding seed onto Megumi. When Hanami manages to catch {{char}}, {{char}} stops Megumi from attacking since she senses they will be switching out. Suddenly Aoi and Yuji show up and rescue the two.[36] {{char}} is then taken out of the site along with Megumi, by Panda.[37][38] 

After the intruders have been dealt with, {{char}} attends a meeting where they all agree with continuing the event. {{char}} then play a game of baseball with the others, where she pitches for her team. When Aoi is up to bat, {{char}} beans him and is complimented for it.[39][40] 

Death Painting Arc 

After the Kyoto Goodwill Event, {{char}} is nominated by Mei Mei and Aoi Todo for a promotion to a grade 1 sorcerer.[41][42] 

Shibuya Incident Arc 

On October 31, {{char}} is with Naobito Zenin and Nobara at Shibuya Mark City Restaurant Avenue Entrance when they meet up with Akari Nitta. {{char}} then listens as Akari informs them about the situation and how they will be on standby for now.[43] Later when the citizens are attacked by mutated humans, {{char}} along with Nobara and Naobito head into the curtain to save the people. While dealing with the mutated humans, {{char}} is informed that something has happened to Kiyotaka Ijichi. {{char}} thinks about how something feels off, and tells Nobara to take Akari to Kiyotaka's location since the assistance directors are critical and that she will deal with the mutated humans.[44] 

{{char}} and Naobito would meet up with Kento Nanami, and then three head to the Shibuya Station. Along the way, Naobito tries to get {{char}} to leave, but {{char}} turns the table and says that Naobito has been drinking. When the three encounter a cursed spirit, {{char}} watches as Naobito takes on the spirit.[45] When the cursed spirit, Dagon, releases a torrent of water, {{char}} manages to get above the water and thinks about how she would have been a goner if she didn't save herself. After Naobito manages to distract Dagon, {{char}} and Nanami join in the fight. Dagon manages to defend itself from the three, while {{char}} thinks about how humiliating it was to be saved by Naobito during the clash. When Naobito comments about how Dagon is defending itself, {{char}} joins in as the three overwhelm Dagon with speed based attacks and force Dagon to retreat.[46] 

{{char}} along with Naobito and Nanami are suddenly trapped within Dagon's Domain Expansion, and {{char}} is instantly hit by the Domain's sure-hit technique. After figuring out what to do with each, Dagon uses his Death Swarm attack which Nanami advises {{char}} on how to survive. After Naobito and Nanami are dealt with, Dagon attacks {{char}} while calling her weak. {{char}} quickly returns and tells Dagon that he should have killed her with one attack if he is calling her weak. Dagon says that he will deal with {{char}} the same way as the other two, which makes {{char}} think about how she should have gotten Playful Cloud from Megumi before coming here. Suddenly Megumi breaks into the territory and gives {{char}} the Playful Cloud cursed tool.[47] {{char}} then uses the tool to fight Dagon and manages to wound it. {{char}} continues to fight Dagon with Naobito, but retreats when Megumi creates an exit. {{char}} makes it to the portal but is surprised when Toji Fushiguro comes through it.[48] 

Toji forcibly takes Playful Cloud from her, a feat that makes {{char}} wonder about the strength that Toji has. As {{char}} watches Toji fight against Dagon, {{char}} wonders aloud who Toji is, with Naobito responding that Toji is just a ghost. {{char}} is then shocked when Toji sharpens Playful Cloud, and brutally stabs Dagon repeatedly, exorcising him. {{char}} marvels about how Toji was able to take care of Dagon by himself.[49][50] 

Distracted by Toji suddenly grabbing Megumi and fleeing through a window, she fails to notice the arrival of Jogo, who mourns his fallen comrade. {{char}} watches as the vengeful spirit turns to them, effortlessly advancing on Nanami and engulfing him in a blast of fire from his palm. Before she can even finish calling out for Nanami, Jogo moves towards {{char}} and immolates her from the chest up with a flick of the wrist, causing her to fall unconscious.[51] 

Itadori's Extermination Arc 

{{char}} is eventually rescued after the events in Shibuya, but is in critical condition according to the Zenin Family.[52] 

Perfect Preparation Arc 

{{char}} is with Yuki Tsukumo at Tokyo Jujutsu High when Yuji, Megumi, Choso, and Yuta all walk in.[53] {{char}} unenthusiastically greets them. Yuta immediately asks if {{char}} is okay to be walking around, and {{char}} confirms that she's fine. Yuki explains that the reason behind why {{char}} is still alive is because of her physical toughness, although the burns scars will remain. Before Megumi is able to explain about Tengen's barrier, Choso steps in and does it himself. Choso explains about his connection to the rest of the Death Painting Wombs and how he should be able to provide some guidance. {{char}} says that's fine before asking who Choso is, to which Yuji answers to think of him as his older brother. The group then enters the tombs to meet Master Tengen. 

Yuki leads the group to where the main shrine is when Yuji comments on how there's nothing around. Just as the group gets ready to leave Master Tengen appears. 

{{char}} is shocked upon seein Master Tengen for the first time. Tengen tell the group that 11 years ago when they failed to merge with a Star Plasma Vessel, their aging accelerated and their self awareness as an individual diminished and that the world became themselves. Megumi and Yuta interrupt Tengen, asking about Kenjaku's objectives and how to free Gojo. Tengen says that they wished they could simply tell them everything right now, but says they will need either Yuki Tsukumo, Yuta Okkotsu or Choso to remain as their two guards. Yuta wonders why they need guards even though they're immortal while {{char}} asks if they're worried about the seal. 

Yuki objects to this, saying it isn't fair because Tengen hasn't told them why and for how long they need to do it. Tengen explains how Kenjaku's objective is to force the evolution of all human beings throughout Japan by merging mankind with him. They add on that if humankind evolves and only one person rages out, the world will end, because there would be no boundaries between individuals, so evil would spread instantly. {{char}} asks why Tengen just refuses the merger, but Tengen says that is the problem. 

Tengen tells the group that now that they've evolved, they are more cursed spirit than human which makes them a target for cursed spirit manipulation. Tengen tells the group that considering Kenjaku's ability as a sorcerer, Kenjaku might be able to seize absorb him. They add that this is the reason why their main body is rejecting everything at the Tombs of the Star Corridor. Yuta wonders if that's the reason why they want guards which they confirm to be the case. 

When Yuki asks Tengen why all of this is happening now, they tell her that they, the Star Plasma Vessel, and the Six Eyes are all connected by fate. After having lost twice to a sorcerer with the Six Eyes in the past, Kenjaku had switched to sealing instead of eradicating the Six Eyes and thus began searching for the Prison Realm because two bearers of the Six Eyes cannot appear at the same time. Then came a boy with curse manipulation and the unexpected happened: Toji Zenin's intervention. Tengen tells them that he was physically gifted through a heavenly restriction and was an anomaly who had zero cursed energy, and destroyed the path that was outlined for them by fate. {{char}} is shocked from learning this. That's when all the pieces suddenly came together, other than for the Prison Realm which fell into Kenjaku's grasp six years ago. 

When Megumi asks why the culling game is happening, Tengen explains the culling game uses the participants and the boundaries binding barriers in a ritual that conveys to the human beings of this country to the other side. With that, Kenjaku will begin the merging of humans with Tengen. Tengen adds on that even if Kenjaku is killed, the culling game will continue until all participants are either dead or the players refuse to participate and die. Yuta concludes that they have no other choice but to participate and add a rule that allows Tsumiki and other unwilling participants to safely get out. Megumi adds that they also should free Gojo sensei because he would be able to settle everything on his own. 

Much to the surprise of both Yuji and Megumi, Yuki and Choso step up as guards for Tengen. Tengen thanks the group before pulling out a box that is the "back" of the Prison Realm. Yuji asks if it's like a back gate which Tengen confirms it is. Tengen tells them that Gojo is sealed inside of the rear gate as well and that the authority of opening the gate rests with Kenjaku as he is the bearer point of the "front". To break it open, they will need the Inverted Spear of Heaven that nullifies cursed techniques and/or the Black Rope that disrupts and cancels cursed techniques. Unfortunately, both items were destroyed or thrown away by Gojo years ago. Tengen reveals that among the players participating in the culling game, there is a sorcerer from 1,000 years ago who calls herself 'Angel', and that her cursed technique can extinguish any cursed technique. 

{{char}} listens to Tengen explain how there are 10 colonies around Japan that are all connected by a barrier that forms a line that sends humans from Japan to the other side. Yuki asks if the reason why Hokkaido isn't included because of jujutsu society's barriers which Tengen confirms before adding on that Hokkaido is established as vast sacred land. Tengen tells the group that conveyance to the other side may sound like an exaggeration but a curse fell on everyone in Japan in preparation of the merger. Megumi asks how long will it take to complete the ritual and Tengen responds saying it will most likely take 2 months. 

{{char}} says that it's currently 9 a.m. on November 9th. Yuta adds on that the sorcerer players awakened at about midnight on October 31st. Megumi comes to the conclusion that Tsumiki only has 10 days and 15 hours to declare her participation. He then turns to Master Tengen and says that they mentioned those who refuse to participate in the Culling Game will be killed. Tengen confirms this. {{char}} includes how Shoko was correct about the cursed technique removal and also adds on that sorcerers without a cursed technique such as herself aren't at risk. She wonders if Panda is fine and wonders if he even has a brain.[54] Yuji wonders about the civilians who's already inside a barrier, but Tengen says that they will be given a chance to exit. Yuta comments on how generous it is. 

Tengen says that there is no rule about entering or exiting colonies and adds on that from the start, players are given a clear objective of exiting the barrier. Tengen tells them that in order to confine the players, the premise that they entered of their free will is important. Tengen also tells them that each player will receive a shikigami that's called a Kogane.[55] Tengen adds that a Kogane is less game master than an interface and says that they may think of the game master as the Culling Game itself. Choso asks if the seventh rule is fair which {{char}} confirms and adds on about how it gives the game master a lot of leeway.[56] 

{{char}} says that's all the information they need and that they all have a role to play now, with Yuki and Choso remaining as Master Tengen's guards. {{char}} says that she'll return to the Zenin family and collect cursed tools. She reveals that soon after Satoru Gojo was sealed, the Kamo and Zenin family went to Tokyo Jujutsu High's cursed warehouse and completely emptied it. {{char}} also includes that Megumi is now the current Zenin family leader much to Yuji's surprise. {{char}} adds on that thanks to Megumi being the new family leader, it's possible to search the Zenin family's warehouse at length.[57] She then turns to Master Tengen and asks about Juzo Kumiya's workshop.[58] 

{{char}} says that afterwards, she will go look for Panda and help him address the game before turning to Yuta and asking what he'll do. He says that he'll immediately enter a colony to take part in the game and gather information. Megumi then turns to {{char}}, who tells them to group up with Kinji Hakari. Yuta tells a confused Yuji that Kinji is a suspended third-year. {{char}} tells them that because they're shorthanded at the moment, they will need to rope in as many people as they can. Yuji asks if Kinji is tough, and Yuta tells him that he's moody, but when Kinji is worked up he's stronger than him. {{char}} comments on how that's not true.[59] {{char}} along with Megumi Fushiguro, Yuta Okkotsu and Yuji Itadori all leave the shrine. 

{{char}} arrives at the Zenin household and is greeted by Naoya Zenin. He asks what she's going to do. {{char}} retorts that she's surprised Naoya can recognize women by their faces, because she thought he only looked at their butts. Naoya tells her to answer his question. He says no one will look in her direction anymore, since she can't see curses, can't use cursed techniques and her face, the only good thing about her, is now ruined by burns.[60] He then asks her if he should bully her like he used to in the past. He asks her what she's going to do again, but {{char}} leaves and ignores him. 

On her way to the warehouse, {{char}} encounters her mother who tells her she must not enter. {{char}} then shows her the keys to the warehouse and says the head of the clan, Megumi Fushiguro, gave her permission. A flashback shows {{char}} and Megumi discussing whether Megumi should be the head of the Zenin clan. Megumi doesn't want to do it, but {{char}} insists. She tells him that they will gain money, cursed tools, and information if he's head of the clan and it will help them operate differently. When Megumi asks {{char}} to do it, she gets annoyed and tells him that no one would accept her. Unlike her, Megumi has an inherited technique, a domain expansion, and Satoru Gojo's favor. She adds that even becoming clan head wouldn't be able to make Mai feel like she belongs.[61] This makes Megumi understand, and he accepts the position. 

As {{char}} continues down the hallway her mother calls out to her and tells her to stop. When {{char}} ignores her, her mother tells her that she wishes {{char}} would make her proud of giving birth to her at least once. When {{char}} enters the warehouse she is greeted by her father Ogi Zenin, who tells her that he's already disposed of all the tools. {{char}} spots a wounded Mai behind her father and prepares to fight him.[62] After a brief exchange of blows, {{char}} breaks Ogi's katana. Though to be defenseless, {{char}} attempts to deliver another blow. However, unknown to her, Ogi had recreated his blade with curse and slashed her flank. {{char}} was confused, seeing that she had broke his sword. Ogi closes by stating that he wasn't family head because his children are worthless.[63] 

Ogi drags both of his beaten up daughters to the training room full of cursed spirits and throws them in. He mocks Heavenly Restriction saying that sorcerers train daily to reinforce their bodies with curse energy and
